summary: Addresses the 'no static Follower-Force hook' gap (issue #154), per the user's detailed spec: a Follower's own self-referential static Force bonus (FollowerForce, mirroring PersonalityForce's Effect-keyed switch, first case force-while-defending) is visible for targeting regardless of bow state (CardForce/ViewCard) but only joins the unit total when unbowed or Elite (BattleForce), matching how a Follower's printed Force has always behaved. New IsDefendingUnit resolves through an attachment's parent -- caught a real bug (reusing IsAttacking directly on a Follower would always evaluate false, wrong Zone) before it shipped. Separately, PersonalityForce gained ItemForceToWielder: an attached Item's own conditional Force bonus (Kensai's Blade's shape) always conveys to the wielder regardless of the Item's own bow state. Shared-file note: all changed files are within L5R.Core (rules engine) and its test suite, plus docs/ROADMAP.md -- a single rules-lane primitive change; no UI/client files touched.
validation: New FollowerAndItemStaticForceHooks test (2 scenarios): a Follower's conditional Force shows for targeting bowed or not, joins the unit total only unbowed, and correctly distinguishes attacking vs defending; an Item's printed and conditional Force/Chi convey to Kensai and non-Kensai wielders alike regardless of the Item's own bow state. Full suite: 96/96 core + 34/34 published + 8/8 deck format pass. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passes.
remaining: Aggregate/group Force effects ('count controlled cards matching X', 'boost every other card in the unit') are a different, not-yet-built primitive -- noted in issue #154, needed by Ashigaru Guards, Senior Infantry Legion, Utaku Elite Guard and similar cards from the Follower Wave 2 triage.
